jobs.title: Quant Researcher
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Vola Dynamics is the world's most sophisticated software and research company for advanced options analytics. Our volatility fitter and ultra-fast option pricers are the market standard, powering decisions at the world’s leading hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, market makers, and global banks.

In this role, you will research cutting-edge problems in volatility modeling and options valuation for both vanillas and exotics across all asset classes. You will implement your solutions in a modern C++ and Python library that is used by some of the most sophisticated market participants. As part of a rapidly growing team, your work will have an immediate and outsized impact.

We believe that this is one of the most exciting opportunities in quantitative finance right now.

Who You Are

  • You hold a PhD degree in a hard science or mathematics.

  • You have a proven track record of academic or professional research that used numerical algorithms, advanced modeling, or computational methods to solve challenging problems similar to what one might find in mathematical finance, astrophysics, particle physics, or similar fields.

  • You have significant experience using modern C++ to perform large-scale computational calculations, ideally in a high-quality C++ library or framework.

  • You have significant experience using the scientific Python stack (Matplotlib, NumPy, Jupyter, etc) to analyze and visualize research outputs (e.g. real world data, simulations).

  • You are a confident communicator, both verbally and in writing, who can independently produce excellent written documentation and clearly present research to fellow colleagues.

  • You have experience with modern software engineering best practices: interface design, version control, unit testing, documentation.

  • You may have prior industry experience in options market making or derivatives modeling (5 years or less) but this is not required.

  • You are authorized to work in the US.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (C++)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Vola Dynamics is the world's most sophisticated software and research company for advanced options analytics. Our volatility fitter and ultra-fast option pricers are the market standard, powering decisions at the world’s leading hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, market makers, and global banks.

In this role, you'll work directly with our CTO on the design of our large-scale, high-performance C++ quant library. You'll own performance-critical code, work on high-level library design questions, and be the on-staff C++ expert that our team trusts when something needs to be fast and correct.
As part of a small, hands-on team, you'll have real ownership from day one and your work will have an immediate and outsized impact. This is a rare position for an engineer who wants to work on genuinely hard problems at the intersection of numerical software, performance optimization, and software architecture.

We're a hybrid team, in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

What You'll Do

  • Core library development: Build and develop our core C++ quant library, from interface design through implementation, tests, and documentation.

  • Library design: You'll help design the internal APIs that our team uses as well as the external APIs that our clients depend on to power their trading.

  • Performance work: Investigate and profile algorithms, functions, or entire workflows to understand and improve their performance.

  • Quantitative algorithms in production: Work with our quants to implement pricing and numerical models efficiently and correctly.

  • Supporting other developers: Review code, answer design questions, and help teammates (who are strong quants or strong engineers but not always C++ specialists) write better C++.

  • AI tooling: AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex, and similar) are a standard part of how we build software here, and we'll expect you to use them well.

  • Build systems and developer experience: Cut build times, improve the test and CI setup, and improve the developer experience.


Who You Are

  • You have a Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in a computer science or another highly technical discipline (physics, engineering, chemistry, etc.)

  • You have roughly 2 to 6 years of professional C++ experience, or comparable depth from academic or open source work.

  • You've worked substantially in a large C++ codebase, in industry or academia, and you're fluent in modern object-oriented and/or functional programming paradigms.

  • You are proficient in Python and have used at least one other systems language (Rust, C#, Java, etc.).

  • You care how your code reads. You write clear, concise, well-organized C++.

  • You are comfortable with using agent-driven development workflows to generate high-quality code.

  • You're careful. You test your work to know it's right, and you think through numerical edge cases before a client finds them.

  • You're rigorous about performance. You measure first, and you understand how the hardware affects the code you write.

  • You explain your thinking clearly, in code, review comments, design discussions, and writing.

  • You work well independently, and just as well as part of a small, hybrid team.

  • You are authorized to work in the US.

Nice to Have

  • Hardware-aware programming: SIMD, GPUs, cache behavior, concurrency.

  • Active open-source contributor in the C++ ecosystem.

  • Experience working on an options market making or derivatives quant library, or other quantitative finance background.

jobs.title: Legal & Business Operations Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Vola Dynamics is the world's most sophisticated software and research company for advanced options analytics. Our volatility fitter and ultra-fast option pricers are the market standard, powering decisions at the world’s leading hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, market makers, and global banks.

In this role, you'll work directly with our General Counsel, who currently runs legal, finance, HR, tax, and compliance as a one-person function, and you may also provide support to our CEO and COO. Your job is to take the repeatable, detail-heavy work off their plates and, over time, own more of it. You'll touch contracts, client billing, compliance, day-to-day operations, and the things that make this a great place to work, and you'll get broad, hands-on exposure to how a business runs.

As part of a small team, you'll have real ownership from day one and your work will have an immediate and outsized impact. This is a rare seat for someone looking to take on broad ownership, grow fast, and become the person who “just handles it.”

We're a mostly remote team. This role has two set in-office days each week — one in our NYC office and one in our South Norwalk, Connecticut office — to stay in close contact with the leadership team you'll support. The remaining days are remote.

What You'll Do

  • Contracts & legal ops: Intake, organize, assist with, and track client agreements; route documents for e-signature; maintain our contract database and keep renewal and obligation dates from slipping.

  • Billing & revenue operations: Help run the client invoicing cycle, preparing and reconciling invoices against signed contract terms, keeping our CRM accurate, and flagging anything that doesn't tie out.

  • Compliance & corporate housekeeping: Maintain compliance and entity calendars, help assemble documentation, and keep our records clean and audit-ready.

  • Operations & executive support: Own recurring processes, keep projects moving, and provide scheduling, inbox, and document support so nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Culture & team experience: Help make Vola a place people love working! Plan company events and look for small ways to improve everyone's day-to-day. Manage the office experience and facilitate travel arrangements for employees.

  • Work smart with AI: Use modern AI tools to move faster on drafting, data entry, and research, without sacrificing accuracy or quality.

  • Build, don't just do: As you learn each process, help us document and improve it so it runs reliably every time.

Who you Are

  • You have a bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience that demonstrates the same diligence and follow-through.

  • You don't need years of experience. You need to be sharp, meticulous, and hungry to learn. We're open to any background, including those newer to the workforce or making a considered career change.

  • You are relentlessly detail-oriented. You double-check numbers and dates because you can't stand getting them wrong, and a misquoted figure bothers you.

  • You are comfortable with AI tools. As a small team, we lean on AI to work efficiently, but we hold a very high bar for accuracy and quality. You should be eager to use these tools and disciplined about verifying their output, never letting a tool's convenience become an excuse for a wrong number.

  • You are a people person who cares about culture. You notice when something would make the team's day better, and you enjoy making it happen.

  • You are proactive and self-directed. You spot what needs doing and do it without being asked twice.

  • You are a fast, curious learner who genuinely wants to understand every part of a small business, from legal to finance to operations.

  • You are a clear, concise communicator who is comfortable with numbers and documents and strong with Excel, and Google Docs.

  • You are discreet and trustworthy with confidential contract, client, and financial information.

  • You are authorized to work in the US.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Python)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Vola Dynamics is the world's most sophisticated software and research company for advanced options analytics. Our volatility fitter and ultra-fast option pricers are the market standard, powering decisions at the world’s leading hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, market makers, and global banks.

We're seeking a data-oriented Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in developing our next-generation streaming data infrastructure from the ground up. This is a rare chance to design and build a modern trading analytics platform from scratch—one that will power cutting-edge applications built on Vola's advanced options analytics library.

We’re a small, tight-knit, highly technical team that values intellectual rigor, collaboration, and doing good work. You’ll take on broad responsibilities and contribute to work with real-world impact from day one. We help each other build, share ideas openly, and work together to get things done.

We're a hybrid team, in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

What You'll Do

  • Design high-performance APIs: Design and implement robust, scalable, real-time and historical user-facing data APIs in C++, Python, and Rust.

  • Build powerful internal tools: Build powerful internal tools (GUIs, TUIs, etc.) for real-time command & control and meta-analytics that accelerate research and streamline the path from research to production.

  • Develop and maintain production data systems: Develop scalable systems to ingest, transform, and analyze real-time and historical options market data and deploy these on our distributed computing infrastructure.

  • Maintain our data processing library: Architect, build, and maintain the data processing library underpinning our streaming analytics.

  • Use AI: AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex) are a standard part of how we build software here, and we'll expect you to use them well.

  • Own our tech stack: Own and evolve a rapidly growing distributed infrastructure spanning bare-metal servers, self-hosted Kubernetes, and cloud services.


Who You Are

  • You earned a BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.

  • You have between 2 years and 6 years of experience in relevant roles working on production data-oriented systems in Python.

  • You have experience designing, building, and maintaining scaleable, fault-tolerant user-facing APIs for data-focused services or systems.

  • You have hands-on experience deploying orchestration frameworks and containerization technologies such as Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Docker, or Kubernetes.

  • You are skilled at understanding, transforming, analyzing, visualizing, and debugging large numerical datasets.

  • You are comfortable with using agent-driven development workflows to generate high-quality code.

  • You consistently apply software and data engineering best practices, including version control, automated testing, and thorough documentation.

  • You explain your thinking clearly, in code, review comments, design discussions, and writing.

  • You work well independently, and just as well as part of a small, hybrid team.

  • You hold current authorization to work in the US.

 

Our Stack
Python, C++, ClickHouse, Kubernetes, Kafka (Redpanda), Dagster, and Rust.

Nice to Have

  • Active open-source contributor in the Python, C++, or Rust data ecosystems.

  • Experience working with observability/tracing systems or production DevOps workflows.

  • Professional experience working in a systems language (C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.)

  • Experience working on an options market making or derivatives infrastructure, or another quantitative finance background.
